findings.claim: The design adds a persisted withdrawn-versus-replaced distinction without defining any behavior or presentation that needs that distinction.
findings.location: Final implementation contracts → Storage, submission and generations; Deterministic record and transition contract
findings.evidence: The spec adds nullable summary_transitions.rule_change accepting withdrawn or replaced, requires this value in rule supersession submissions, persists it in each Transition, and rechecks it during folding. Both values produce the same Active→Superseded transition, use the same citation and quote guards, and receive the same recently-closed rendering. No replacement linkage, different lifecycle behavior, or display of the distinction is specified. The design therefore requires an additional two-value contract across submission, storage and folding without identifying a consumer that needs those separate values.
